lines.en: label mollylust10:
scene mollyalsowantsxmasdick1
There is a knock at the door.
lines.zh: 门口传来敲门声。

lines.en: This happens sometimes.
lines.zh: 这种事时有发生。

lines.en: Normally not with Futaba, though.
lines.zh: 不过和 Futaba 在一起时通常不会。

lines.en: Apart from a few spare instances, she’s been one of the most careful of all.
lines.zh: 除了少数几次例外，她一直是所有人里最小心的一个。

lines.en: That changes today.
lines.zh: 今天这一点变了。

lines.en: The only question is {i}who{/i} is intruding this time?
lines.zh: 唯一的问题是，这次闯进来的是{i}谁{/i}？

lines.en: Another knock.
lines.zh: 又是一阵敲门声。

lines.en: Can we wait them out?
lines.zh: 我们能等到他们走吗？

lines.en: Will the person on the other end simply go away if we wait for {i}long{/i} enough?
lines.zh: 只要我们等得{i}够久{/i}，门外那个人就会自己走掉吗？

lines.en: : What...do we do?
lines.zh: : 我们……怎么办？

lines.en: : There are a few things we {i}can{/i} do.
lines.zh: : 我们有几件事{i}可以{/i}做。

lines.en: : I’d appreciate it if you would start naming them because I’m both extremely lightheaded and also...in a minor state of shock, I think?
lines.zh: : 麻烦您开始列举一下，因为我现在既晕得厉害，而且……大概还有点轻微休克？

lines.en: : You said you didn’t notice being followed, right?
lines.zh: : 你说你没注意到有人跟着，对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah?...
: Then, do you think one of the others got tired of waiting around and wants a piece of me too?
lines.zh: : 那你觉得，是不是其他人等得不耐烦了，也想分我一杯羹？

lines.en: : I...uhh...maybe?
lines.zh: : 我……呃……也许吧？

lines.en: : But I’m not really...
lines.zh: : 可我其实不太……

lines.en: : You want me all to yourself?
lines.zh: : 你想独占我？

lines.en: : Uh-huh...
lines.zh: : 嗯哼……

lines.en: : You think you’re good enough for that?
lines.zh: : 你觉得你有那个本事吗？

lines.en: scene mollyalsowantsxmasdick3
: I really hope you’re still in character and not being serious right now.
lines.zh: : 我真希望你现在还在角色里，不是在认真的。

lines.en: : Of course I’m “still in character.” I’m just not really sure how to handle this apart from either waiting until they go away, which clearly isn’t going to work, or letting {i}them{/i} in as well.
lines.zh: : 我当然「还在角色里」。我只是真不知道该怎么处理——要么等他们走，可那显然行不通；要么干脆也让{i}他们{/i}进来。

lines.en: : But we don’t even know {i}who{/i} it is.
lines.zh: : 可我们连是{i}谁{/i}都不知道。

lines.en: : Well, who do you {i}want{/i} it to be?
lines.zh: : 那你{i}希望{/i}是谁？

lines.en: : Henry Cavill.
lines.zh: : Henry Cavill。

lines.en: : Who?
: Some...hot guy. He’s an actor.
lines.zh: : 一个……很帅的男人。他是个演员。

lines.en: : I doubt it’s him, Futaba. It has to be one of the girls. Besides, I wouldn’t want to share you with some other guy anyway.
lines.zh: : 我怀疑不是他，Futaba。肯定是那些女孩中的一个。再说了，我本来也不想跟别的男人分享你。

lines.en: : Sure. But I don’t want to share you with some other {i}girl.{/i} So neither one of us is going to get what we want.
lines.zh: : 说得也是。可我也不想跟别的{i}女孩{/i}分享你。所以我们俩谁都得不到想要的。

lines.en: : Do you want to try hiding then?
lines.zh: : 那你想试试躲起来吗？

lines.en: : {i}Where?{/i} This is a bathroom. There’s nowhere {i}to{/i} hide.
lines.zh: : {i}躲哪儿{/i}？这是卫生间。没地方{i}可躲{/i}。

lines.en: scene black
I carefully slide Futaba back to the ground so she can straighten her dress out and...at least {i}attempt{/i} to disguise the fact that I emptied myself into her several minutes ago.
lines.zh: 我小心地把 Futaba 放回地上，让她把裙子整理好……至少{i}尽量{/i}掩饰几分钟前我在她体内射精这件事。

lines.en: The knocking goes on for another five minutes before I give in and decide to open the door.
lines.zh: 敲门声又持续了五分钟，我终于妥协，决定去开门。

lines.en: scene mollyalsowantsxmasdick4
But who I find on the other side is slightly unexpected. Especially since I didn’t see her with Futaba’s group when the two of us “snuck” away.
lines.zh: 可门外站着的人有点出乎意料。尤其是我和 Futaba「偷偷」溜走的时候，我并没在 Futaba 那群人里看到她。

lines.en: : Something suspicious is afoot here...
lines.zh: : 这里有些可疑的事情正在发生……

lines.en: : What makes you say that, Molly?
lines.zh: : 你凭什么这么说，Molly？

lines.en: scene mollyalsowantsxmasdick5
: The fact that you are not wearing pants.
lines.zh: : 因为您没穿裤子。

lines.en: : Oh. Shit.
lines.zh: : 哦。操。

lines.en: : Seriously, Sensei?! You had like five whole minutes to put them back on!
lines.zh: : 说真的，老师？！您有整整五分钟可以把裤子穿回去啊！

lines.en: : Yeah, but you didn’t warn me. I’m much more used to having my pants off than on, so this is kind of {i}your{/i} fault too.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可你没提醒我。我不穿裤子的时候可比穿的时候多得多，所以这也有{i}你的{/i}错。

lines.en: scene mollyalsowantsxmasdick6
: Then it’s true what the innkeeper says — that a knight’s been having his way with the farmer’s daughter.
lines.zh: : 那旅店老板说的是真的了——一位骑士正在对农家女儿为所欲为。

lines.en: : I thought your father was an architect, Futaba?
lines.zh: : 我以为你父亲是建筑师呢，Futaba？

lines.en: : I think she’s just...roleplaying like normal, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我想她只是……像平时一样在角色扮演，老师。

lines.en: : Is now {i}really{/i} the best time be running around and unlocking h-scenes, Sir? Because you never know when you might encounter another player embarking on various side quests.
lines.zh: : 先生，现在{i}真的{/i}是到处乱跑、解锁 H 场景的好时机吗？因为你永远不知道什么时候会撞上另一个正在跑各种支线任务的玩家。

lines.en: scene mollyalsowantsxmasdick7

: Like {i}me{/i} for example. I was merely minding my own business, scouring Tsukioka Manor for dungeons to crawl through when- what’s this? {i}Screams{/i} coming from a nearby cave? I simply {i}had{/i} to investigate.
lines.zh: : 比如{i}我{/i}。我本来只是在做自己的事，在 Tsukioka 庄园里搜寻可以钻进去的地下城，结果——这是什么？附近洞穴传来的{i}尖叫声{/i}？我{i}非{/i}调查一下不可。

lines.en: : Sure. But you’re not delusional to the point where you’d hear those screams and not immediately interpret them as people having sex. You knew what you were walking into.
lines.zh: : 行吧。可你还没妄想成那样——听见那些尖叫却不会立刻反应过来是有人在做爱。你清楚自己要闯进来的是什么场面。

lines.en: scene mollyalsowantsxmasdick8
: Aye! And I am prepared for whatever it is that will happen to me next, Sir!
lines.zh: : 是！而且接下来无论发生什么，我都准备好了，先生！

lines.en: : Oh, god...
lines.zh: : 哦，天哪……

lines.en: : Molly, did you really mean to...intrude? If you knew it was me in here with Sensei-
lines.zh: : Molly，你当真是故意……要闯进来的？如果你知道是我和老师在里面——

lines.en: scene mollyalsowantsxmasdick9
: Oh, that much was unknown to me. I had assumed the Supreme Overlord was in here with someone more...{i}prone{/i} to engaging in illicit affairs at parties.
lines.zh: : 哦，那一点我可不知道。我本来以为至高霸主是和某个更……{i}喜欢{/i}在派对上搞不正当关系的人在里面。

lines.en: : L...Like who?
lines.zh: : 比、比如谁？

lines.en: : Most others, honestly. This is rather unlike you, Xessaxia. But I appreciate the boldness and will allow you to carry your Christmas miracle over to our next session.
lines.zh: : 说实话，大多数其他人。这可不太像你，Xessaxia。不过我很欣赏这份胆量，允许你把你的圣诞奇迹带到我们下次团里去。

lines.en: : Greaaaaat. What an...awesome reward in exchange for you now knowing that Sensei and I are...{i}hanging out.{/i}
lines.zh: : 太、好、了。多棒的奖励啊——代价是你现在知道我和老师在……一起{i}厮混{/i}了。

lines.en: : {i}Now?{/i}
: Wonderful. So you knew too, then. And, since you’re here, I’m assuming Sensei is...{i}hanging out{/i} with you as well.
lines.zh: : 好极了。那么你也早就知道了。而且，既然你在这儿，我想老师也……在跟你{i}厮混{/i}。

lines.en: : Molly’s new to the harem.
lines.zh: : Molly 是后宫的新人。

lines.en: scene mollyalsowantsxmasdick10
: Aye! Which means it’s time for me to catch up! And what better place to fall deeper into corruption than a mysterious {i}cave{/i} while being watched by a satyr?!
lines.zh: : 是！这意味着我该迎头赶上了！而要说在什么地方能更深地堕落，还有什么比在一个神秘{i}洞穴{/i}里、被一只萨堤尔注视着更好的呢？！

lines.en: scene mollyalsowantsxmasdick11
: Unless said satyr would rather take part in the festivities as well. Which I assume is quite unlikely given that she rolled a natural one on sexuality.
lines.zh: : 除非那位萨堤尔也想加入这场狂欢。不过考虑到她在性向上掷出了天然 1 点，我想那可能性相当低。

lines.en: : Futaba?
lines.zh: : Futaba？

lines.en: : Wha- of course not. You said no to Henry Cavill, so it’s only fair that I-
lines.zh: : 什么——当然不。你都拒绝了 Henry Cavill，那我也——

lines.en: scene mollyalsowantsxmasdick12
: Got it. I’ll just take care of Molly next then.
lines.zh: : 明白了。那我接下来就照顾 Molly 好了。

lines.en: : EYEAAHH?! S...SIR?!
lines.zh: : EYEAAHH？！先、先生？！

lines.en: : While I’m still in the room?!
lines.zh: : 当着我的面？！

lines.en: : Yeah. You could use some time to recover, right?
lines.zh: : 是啊。你也需要点时间恢复，对吧？

lines.en: : Well...yes! But I don’t think this is particularly comfortable for either one of us!
lines.zh: : 嗯……是的！可我觉得这对我们俩来说都特别不舒服！

lines.en: I lift Molly up and throw her onto some kind of dresser thing or...I don’t know. I’m sure there’s some fancier word for it that I don’t know about because I wasn’t privileged enough to grow up in a place like this.
lines.zh: 我把 Molly 抱起来，扔到某个像是梳妆台的东西上……或者，我也不知道。我敢肯定它有个更讲究的名字，只是我不知道——毕竟我没那个福气在这种地方长大。

lines.en: However, I {i}have{/i} managed to somehow claw my way to the top. So I’ve reached the point where I have no trouble reaping and tending to the crops others have painstakingly grown.
lines.zh: 不过，我{i}总算{/i}一路爬到了顶上。所以到如今，收割并照料别人辛苦种下的庄稼，对我来说已经毫无障碍。

lines.en: : Are you...are we going to, like...actually {i}do it{/i} this time, Sir?
lines.zh: : 您……我们这次是要……{i}真的做{/i}吗，先生？

lines.en: : No. I just came inside your friend and it’ll take me a little while to {i}recharge.{/i} But that doesn’t mean I can’t figure out what to do with you.
lines.zh: : 不。我刚射在你朋友里面，得缓一会儿才能{i}重新充电{/i}。但这不妨碍我琢磨该怎么处理你。

lines.en: scene mollyalsowantsxmasdick13
: Tch. It’s always the farmer’s daughter. Just once, I’d like the knight to have his way with another traveler instead.
lines.zh: : 啧。每次都是农家女儿。哪怕只有一次，我也想看骑士对另一个旅人下手。

lines.en: : Yes. Forgive me for having the {i}audacity{/i} to have sex with Sensei where I thought no one would find us.
lines.zh: : 是啊。请原谅我{i}胆大包天{/i}，在一个我以为没人会找到的地方跟老师做爱。

lines.en: scene mollyalsowantsxmasdick14
: A...Always check the stables?
lines.zh: : 永、永远要检查马厩？

lines.en: : I thought this was a {i}cave.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我以为这是{i}洞穴{/i}。

lines.en: : Check...there too! The fact of the matter is, the two of you decided to have your tryst in a place that someone experienced in CG-hunting would surely-
lines.zh: : 那里……也要检查！事实是，你们俩选了个地方幽会，而任何一个有经验的 CG 猎人肯定会——

lines.en: scene mollyalsowantsxmasdick15
: FiiiiIIIiIIIIiIIIIiiiiIINd?!!?!?! AaAAAaah! Sir!?
lines.zh: : FiiiiIIIiIIIIiIIIIiiiiIINd?!!?!?! AaAAAaah! Sir!?

lines.en: : I don’t really know why I thought you wouldn’t be the type to do something like this, Molly.
lines.zh: : 我真不知道自己为什么会觉得你不是会做这种事的人，Molly。

lines.en: : D...D-Do what?! I was merely...hunting slimes when...this man seized me and...aaaAaaah!
lines.zh: : 干、干什么？！我只是……在猎杀史莱姆，结果……这个男人抓住了我，然后……啊啊啊啊啊！

lines.en: I shift her panties to the side and slip two of my fingers inside of her.
lines.zh: 我把她的内裤拨到一边，将两根手指滑了进去。

lines.en: I figure I won’t have to start slowly given that she’s surely “practiced” on herself before today.
lines.zh: 我想不必慢慢来了——在今天之前，她肯定已经在自己身上「练」过了。

lines.en: Probably with me too if the voices that come and go are worth believing.
lines.zh: 如果那些来来去去的声音可信的话，大概还带着我一起练过。

lines.en: The monks are gone for now. The sounds that bounce off of the marble must have scared them away.
lines.zh: 僧侣们暂时走了。那些在大理石上回弹的声音，大概把他们吓跑了。

lines.en: They’re plentiful now. Two felt so lonely, but three? This is how it {i}should{/i} be. Even if one of them is only here reluctantly.
lines.zh: 现在他们又多起来了。两个的时候太寂寞，可三个？{i}就该{/i}是这个样子。哪怕其中一个只是勉强待在这儿。

lines.en: : So...what am I supposed to do now? Just wait?
lines.zh: : 那么……我现在该做什么？就干等着？

lines.en: : K...Kiss me...Xessaxia!
lines.zh: : 亲……亲我……Xessaxia！

lines.en: : No.
: Hah...haaah...it was...worth a shot! I’m taking...away your...Christmas miracle!
lines.zh: : 哈……哈啊……至少……值得一试！我要……收回你的……圣诞奇迹！

lines.en: : Want to try talking dirty again, Futaba? You were getting really into it when it was just the two of us.
lines.zh: : 想再试试说脏话吗，Futaba？方才只有我们两个的时候，你可是相当入戏。

lines.en: scene mollyalsowantsxmasdick16
: To...{i}who?{/i} You’re touching Molly, not me. Am I supposed to...narrate it? How does this work?
lines.zh: : 对……对{i}谁{/i}说？您在摸的是 Molly，不是我。难道要我……旁白吗？这该怎么弄？

lines.en: : I...think a little...narration would...be nice!
lines.zh: : 我……觉得来点……旁白……挺好的！

lines.en: : Then, uhh...
lines.zh: : 那么，呃……

lines.en: scene mollyalsowantsxmasdick17
: Used his hands to...bring pleasure to the...traveler...It was the only way to...satisfy his...curiosities and...uhh...lust?
lines.zh: : 用他的手……给那位旅人……带来快乐……这是满足他……好奇心和……呃……欲望的唯一办法？

lines.en: : It sounds like I’m listening to an audio-book all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 这听起来怎么突然像在听有声书。

lines.en: scene mollyalsowantsxmasdick18
: Aaaah! Forget it! I’ll just go back to the party and cover for Molly or something!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊！算了！我还是回派对上去，帮 Molly 打个掩护什么的！

lines.en: scene black
: Enjoy the {i}knight,{/i} you thief! I hope he...sees how evil you are and...can’t get hard because of it!
lines.zh: : 好好享受那位{i}骑士{/i}吧，你这小偷！我希望他……看清你有多邪恶，然后……因此硬不起来！

lines.en: Futaba slams the door behind her and, presumably, runs down the hall to tear herself away from the now-screaming Molly MacCormack.
lines.zh: Futaba 摔门而去，大概是顺着走廊跑开，好把自己从正在尖叫的 Molly MacCormack 身边拽走。

lines.en: I reach over and lock the door behind her.
lines.zh: 我伸手把她身后的门反锁上。

lines.en: scene mollyalsowantsxmasdick19
It never makes much of a difference, but at least it’ll prevent someone else from barging in while I’m stirring the insides of a small Irish girl with my fingers.
lines.zh: 这从来起不了多大作用，但至少能防止在我用手指搅动一个爱尔兰小姑娘体内的时候，再有别人闯进来。

lines.en: : Mmnghg! S...Sir! I’m sorry for...interrupting! I had assumed that...probability favored...the bisexuals!
lines.zh: : Mmnghg！先……先生！对不起……打扰了！我本来以为……概率会偏向……双性恋那一边！

lines.en: : You knocked on the door expecting to find yourself in a threesome moments later?
lines.zh: : 你敲门的时候，是抱着「过一会儿就能加入三人行」的期待？

lines.en: : It was less of an...expectation and...more of a...wish!
lines.zh: : 那与其说是……期待，不如说是……愿望！

lines.en: : You’re that much of a pervert, huh?
lines.zh: : 你色到这个地步啊？

lines.en: scene mollyalsowantsxmasdick20
: Hah...this should...come as no surprise to you...Sir!...
lines.zh: : 哈……这……您该不会感到意外吧……先生！……

lines.en: : We’ve...reached the point where...ngaaah...things like that are...bound to happen! The harem has...grown too large...for any one of us...to {i}ever{/i} expect to get to you alone! So forgive me for...wanting to party up!
lines.zh: : 我们已经……到了这种地步……嗯啊啊……这种事……迟早会发生！后宫已经……太大了……我们谁都{i}别想{/i}……独占您！所以请原谅我……想组队！

lines.en: scene mollyalsowantsxmasdick21
: But I suppose that...now I..{i}aaAaaaAahhh...{/i}finally get to experience a...holiday tryst!
lines.zh: : 不过我想……现在……{i}啊啊啊啊{/i}……我终于能体验一次……节日幽会了！

lines.en: At least one that you’re conscious for.
lines.zh: : 至少这次你是清醒的。

lines.en: : That feels...amazing, Sir...
lines.zh: : 感觉……好极了，先生……

lines.en: : So much better...than when I do it!...
lines.zh: : 比我自己弄的时候……好太多了！……

lines.en: : And you do it a lot, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 而你还经常弄，对吧？

lines.en: : Yes...so often, Sir...I’m such a naughty girl...I’m so needy...I want it so bad...every day...every night...I can’t...be sated...Sir!
lines.zh: : 是的……非常频繁，先生……我是个这么坏的女孩……我这么饥渴……我好想要……每一天……每一夜……我都……得不到满足……先生！

lines.en: : What do you think about when you do it?
lines.zh: : 你弄的时候在想什么？

lines.en: scene mollyalsowantsxmasdick22
: That...ngah...depends...Sir!
lines.zh: : 那……嗯啊……要看情况……先生！

lines.en: : On what?
lines.zh: : 看什么？

lines.en: : On...whatever mood I’m in that day...
lines.zh: : 看……那天我是什么心情……

lines.en: : Sometimes...I like to imagine myself...being used by a horde of goblins...
lines.zh: : 有时候……我喜欢想象自己……被一大群哥布林使用……

lines.en: : And other days...that I’m the...regent queen of an ancient elven society...holding the head of an aspiring suitor between my legs...
lines.zh: : 另一些日子……我会想象自己是……古老精灵社会的摄政女王……把一个觊觎者的头夹在两腿之间……

lines.en: : That is an extremely specific fantasy.
lines.zh: : 这幻想可真够具体的。

lines.en: : It’s not...always like that, Sir...
lines.zh: : 也……不总是那样，先生……

lines.en: : A lot of the time, I...aah...I just think about...exactly what I’m thinking right now...
lines.zh: : 很多时候，我……啊……我想的就正是……此刻我在想的事……

lines.en: : Which is?
lines.zh: : 是什么？

lines.en: scene mollyalsowantsxmasdick23
: How I want you to bend me over and fuck my little brains out, S-
lines.zh: : 我多想让您把我按弯下腰，把我的小脑浆都肏出来，先——

lines.en: scene mollyalsowantsxmasdick24
